products.quality: Reference rotary: Laser Tools -> Rotary Setup (Ctrl+R), Roller vs Chuck type, axis assignment (Y/Z/A), mm-per-rotation, Roller/Object Diameter, Mirror Output, and a Test button that spins one 360-degree rotation to verify calibration.

Docs (CNC Types explainer) state verbatim: 'MillMage does not support rotaries at this time.' No rotary/4th-axis/wrapping operation exists in the CAM list (Pocket/Profile/Drill/Surfacing/V-carve/Relief).
No rotary UI or roller/chuck wizard. Rotary runs as the scaled Y axis by editing GRBL $101 steps/mm in the console (third-party machine guides); manual calibration only, no diameter entry.

xTool Studio/XCS: pick Roller or Chuck/Jaw mode for RA2/RA3, enter perimeter or diameter; roller offers S/M/L levels. Framing preview before run. Supported across current devices (P2/P2S, F2, F1 Ultra).
No native 4th-axis/rotary support; X-Carve's GRBL lacks a 4th axis. Community threads treat rotary as DIY-only; Easel exposes no rotary setup.

Circumference mapped from mm-per-rotation plus measured Object/Roller Diameter; wrong values leave output 'shrunk or stretched'. Test button validates one revolution. No visual wrapped preview - axis remapped at output. HW-unverified.
No rotary support, so there is no rotary output path to assess (CNC Types explainer: 'MillMage does not support rotaries at this time').

Correctness depends entirely on manually calibrating $101 so one revolution equals circumference; no per-object diameter mapping, so recalibrate per diameter. Design rolls onto itself if wider than circumference. HW-unverified.
Perimeter/diameter entry maps circumference; roller-diameter/level presets. Framing traces placement before run. Vendor-documented; circumference accuracy not independently HW-verified in this audit.
No rotary support, so no rotary output path exists; Easel outputs flat 2.5D toolpaths only.

Dedicated Focus Test generator (Laser Tools -> Focus Test): Z-stepped lines labeled by height to find focus; Material-thickness field, per-layer Z offset and Z-step-per-pass, per-lens autofocus, relative/absolute Z moves.

Laser focus/autofocus N/A. CNC Z tooling present: XYZ/puck probe block plus tool-length probing (Probing guide), depth-per-pass control. Stock/thickness handled via project origin, not a focus-ramp test.
No focus test, material-thickness, or autofocus tooling in the usage docs; diode focus is set manually on hardware. Z jog only if the machine happens to have a Z axis.

Standout autofocus: an Auto-measure button drives on-machine distance measurement, reports material thickness and overlaps red/blue spots; manual-focus fallback per machine. Not suited to transparent/reflective/black-acrylic materials.
Laser focus N/A. Z-probe supported for automatic Z-zeroing; stock thickness set in the workpiece; two-stage roughing+detail carves. Beginner-friendly Z handling, no focus-ramp test.
Automated per-layer Air Assist is the headline specialty toggle (emits M7/M8 when the layer runs, disable per layer). No curved/tilted-surface compensation in LightBurn.

No laser air assist or curved-surface compensation. CNC analog present: per-operation automated Coolant and Vacuum toggles that switch on when the operation begins (require a controller-connected system).
No automated air-assist toggle or surface compensation. Only user-defined Custom Buttons can emit M7/M8/M9 macros manually; no curved/tilted-surface mode exists.
Rich specialty set: Curve Process height-maps curved/uneven surfaces (mark two vertices, auto-measures points, builds a model), and Smart Air Assist Auto mode auto-varies airflow engrave-vs-cut.
No air assist (CNC), no curved/tilted-surface compensation, no rotary specialty modes. Easel targets flat 2.5D stock only.
